title: CRISPRware: an efficient method for contextual gRNA library design
authors: Eric Malekos, Christy Montano, Susan Carpenter
relevance_to_cellguide: CRISPRware is a Python package for context-specific gRNA library design that leverages NGS data and accounts for genetic variation, enabling allele-specific guide design genome-wide across CRISPR modalities (KO/CRISPRi/CRISPRa), with built-in on-target and off-target scoring. Directly relevant to CLAUDE.md's 'guide sequence libraries' topic seed and to Agent 3's guide_scoring.py as a reference implementation for combining on-/off-target scoring with contextual (cell/genotype) constraints in a single library-design tool.
